content: Symmetric keys and asymmetric private keys shall be im- ported and exported in a secure format. Status: DRAFT Description: The crypto stack shall provide interfaces for import and export of symmetric keys and asymmetric private keys in a secure format. Rationale: Support secure distribution of keys from a backend system and/or migration or backup of keys between systems. Dependencies: – Use Case: Wrapping / unwrapping keys without exposing the key values. Supporting Material: –
